title: The canonical diagonal right derived model
statement: For an additive functor F:C→D between abelian categories with the indicated derived localizations and K-injective resolutions in C, construct a DiagonalRightDerived F as defined in [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit]. Its functor is literally F.rightDerivedFunctor, and its full unit on every complex is rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ. It has K-injective computation, the canonical commutation with shifts and the triangulated structure.

proof.text: Quasi-isomorphisms between K-injective complexes are homotopy equivalences. An additive functor preserves homotopy equivalences, so the K-injective localizer derives F.
The published cochain unit is invertible on K-injectives. Apply the localizer universal-property criterion, and retain the canonical shift and triangulated instances.

mathlib_searches.query: Transport integration identity through a natural transformation and endpoint isomorphisms; canonical right derived functor computed on K injective complexes; diagonal trace coefficient extension and uniformizer quotient annihilation

mathlib_searches.verdict: No complete existing diagonal coefficient theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Twelve hits, including rightDerivedUnique and LocalizerMorphism.Derives construction APIs. These provide the canonical unit universal property; they do not assert the geometric coefficient endpoints.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the published universal-property API for the canonical derived model.
